455896610.body: save fixes in pkg mode and faster read batches fpkg pkg support is experimental , and a pkg game can run worse than the same game in zstd packs. if a game stutters as a pkg, try it in zstd packs and tell us in an issue what s new faster read batches: a game s next batch of reads now starts while the previous one is still finishing. on our test games a batch completes about 10 sooner in pkg mode, and a zstd game that queued its reads badly went from 98 ms to 5 ms a batch. the disk read pool grows from 6 to 8 threads to keep up fixes games that failed every save in pkg mode, such as marvel s wolverine 116 : the save service cannot open the game s save icon in pkg mode so the runtime now reads the icon and hands it over itself, also when the game is installed on an m.2 drive. not yet confirmed by the reporter hades hung when closed and showed 0xa0024301 in pkg mode 114 . shared save mounts are removed: a save mount the game already holds is passed back as busy, as on a retail console dirt 5 crashed about 15 s after launch, then hung on a black screen, in pkg mode 117 : folders listed with a small buffer now show their files on disk as well as the packed ones marvel cosmic invasion aborted at launch 111 , and scott pilgrim ex is fixed by the same change: a folder that exists only in the packs no longer reports a stale not found error at the end of its listing thanks jamesst20 fixed marvel cosmic invasion and scott pilgrim ex 113 and dirt 5 118 , traced from core dumps, and found the save bug behind the hades hang 115 pristmc-code sent detailed reports with core dumps and traces for marvel cosmic invasion 111 , hades 114 and dirt 5 117 , and tested every fix build on a console fever86 sent the logs for marvel s wolverine 116 and found that the save failure happened only on m.2 strongt1me helped triage 111 how to use fpkg games: launch with kraken-mount zstd, lz4 and folder games: copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in its settings or kraken mount zstd and lz4 packs can be made with ps5-dump-forge

454608043.body: new edit in the cli. ps5-dump-forge edit changes a game s files without mounting it, for scripts: --add : , --delete , --rename : and --mkdir , applied in the order given, in place or with --rebuild . it runs the same job as the edit tab static linux cli for arm64. a new linux-arm64-musl tarball carries the fully static ps5-dump-forge cli for arm64 nases and boards, beside the x86-64 one fixes ffpfsc unsupported pfs pointer layout . an image whose file ends at its last data byte, instead of at the end of its last 64 kib block, was refused. it now reads; one cut into its data is still refused ampr index read as damaged. an ampr emu.index whose slot table starts at a multiple of 8 bytes a package s own index, crisis core was called damaged and written afresh on conversion. it now reads, and is kept when it lists exactly the output s files. when an index really is damaged, the job log now says why thanks jamesst20 made their first contribution in 69, which brought the cli s edit command strongt1me sent 68 .ffpfsc images with a short last block , 67 the arm64 static cli , 64 8-byte aligned ampr index and 62 why an index is damaged , and keeps helping triage issues tomeq82 reported 65 with the byte dumps that settled it, n3uma-lovable 66 and cherritm the crisis core index quer3q ampr-emu-ng 86
